approved_canonical_row.title: Local coherent acyclicity on sufficiently small polydiscs

items.title: Local coherent acyclicity on sufficiently small polydiscs
items.statement: Assume AC. Let F be coherent analytic on a neighborhood of a point x in C^N. There is a coordinate polydisc W about x such that for every nonempty coordinate polydisc D⊂W and every q>0, H^q(D,F|_D)=0. Scalar sheaf cohomology on such D is computed by its smooth Dolbeault resolution. One can choose W subordinate to a partial finite-rank free resolution of F of length exceeding 2N. The assertion is local in the supplied resolution neighborhood; no untwisted projective Cartan A/B or global Stein generation theorem is asserted.
items.strategy: Write scalar Dolbeault sheaf exactness from the local lemma and smooth-module acyclicity, then global scalar polydisc vanishing. Establish the ordinary sheaf cohomological-dimension bound H^j(D,G)=0 for j>2N for arbitrary abelian sheaves on a polydisc, by explicit finite-order refinements/paracompact Čech comparison, not by misusing a compact-support bound. Choose a partial free resolution longer than 2N on W; dimension shift along its coherent kernels on every D⊂W. No global Cartan A/B.
items.axiom_base: ZF + full AC; record resolutions, countable shrinking/diagonal choices, Baire/Fréchet arguments and supplier-inherited choice uses precisely. No physical premise.

approved_canonical_row.title: Finite-dimensional coherent cohomology on compact projective space

items.title: Finite-dimensional coherent cohomology on compact projective space
items.statement: Assume AC. For 0≤r≤3 and any coherent analytic O_{P^r(C)}-module F, every H^q(P^r(C),F), q≥0, is finite-dimensional. With the locally defined coherent-section Fréchet topology and the induced Čech quotient topology these cohomology groups are Hausdorff. The proof includes the required Fréchet open-mapping and Schwartz compact-complex finiteness results, local coherent-section topology, and compactness of restriction; none is presumed to follow from a Banach-only or one-variable theorem.
items.strategy: Develop metrizable complete locally convex section spaces and prove the Fréchet open-mapping theorem by Baire and successive approximation; Banach open mapping is only an analogy. Prove Schwartz compact-perturbation and its compact morphism of Fréchet complexes finite-dimensional/Hausdorff cohomology corollary. Define coherent section topology as a closed-relation quotient and show chart/generator independence using Artin–Rees/Krull. Prove several-variable Montel from polydisc Cauchy estimates, Ascoli and diagonal compact exhaustion (the imported named Montel theorem is plane-only). Prove compact coherent restriction maps. Construct finite nested Leray covers of P^r subordinate to distinguished resolution neighborhoods and justify all finite-intersection acyclicity. If intersections are not coordinate polydiscs, explicitly prove their pseudoconvex chart geometry and scalar Dolbeault vanishing, then coherent dimension shifting; do not apply pair3 to arbitrary intersections. Apply the proved compact-complex theorem to the resulting restriction of Čech complexes. This contains substantial internal prerequisites and remains unproved.
items.axiom_base: ZF + full AC; record resolutions, countable shrinking/diagonal choices, Baire/Fréchet arguments and supplier-inherited choice uses precisely. No physical premise.
